tool.title: Sample solicitation preparation checklist
tool.summary: Checks three made-up preparation steps before a fictional notice is filed. Every rule and citation in this tool is invented for testing.

citations.label: Sample Rule 44.1(a) (fictional)
citations.note: States that a made-up public notice summary must be attached

citations.label: Sample Rule 44.2(b) (fictional)
citations.note: States when the optional transition schedule applies

scope_limits: Every rule and citation here is fictional. Do not use this checklist for a real solicitation.

items.label: Transition schedule is attached
items.help: Mark Not applicable when there is no prior order.

worked_examples.label: Required summary present, transition schedule not applicable, advisory glossary omitted
Required summary missing leaves one unmet required item
